title: dbtt-curve-ml: data and code for 'Learning the Ductile-to-Brittle Transition Curve of Steels'
description: Compiled Charpy impact database (604 measurements, 58 steels, 40 publications), in-house cast-steel data, analysis code (direct and tanh-equation-constrained XGBoost and neural-network models) and all results of the manuscript 'Learning the Ductile-to-Brittle Transition Curve of Steels: Direct Machine Learning versus Empirical-Equation-Constrained Models with Validation on In-House Cast Steels' (submitted to Metals, MDPI).
